# Tip & Toe Spa

> Nail salon & spa · Shops at Tech Ridge based in Austin, Texas. Full sets, SNS dip, gel manicures, spa pedicures and eyebrow waxing at the Shops at Tech Ridge on North I-35. Walk in any day of the week and sit down with a team some regulars have trusted for nearly ten years.

- Phone: (512) 989-0565
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Wells Branch, Round Rock, Manor
- Google rating: 3.6 from 187 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/tip-and-toe-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/tip-and-toe-spa/book.html

## Services
- Full sets & refills: Regular, solar, pink & white, SNS dip and gel sets, plus refills when they grow out.
- Manicures & gel: Classic manicures, French tips and glossy gel color that lasts, from soft pinks to deep navy.
- Pedicures: Spa pedicures that take their time, with a warm soak, massage and fresh color on your toes.
- Nail design: Cat eye shimmer, accent nails, stripes and seasonal art on top of any set.
- Silk wraps & repairs: Wraps to strengthen natural nails and quick fixes for a broken nail.
- Brows & lashes: Eyebrow waxing and eyelash extensions, from techs our regulars trust with their faces.

## About
Tip & Toe Spa is in the Shops at Tech Ridge at 12901 N Interstate Hwy 35, next door to Dollar Tree, with plenty of parking out front. Look for the red Tip&ToeSpa sign. Inside it's bright and easygoing: peach walls, cream curtains, cobalt pendant lights, a wall of polish colors and our price board behind the front desk. A lot of our clients have been coming for years. One regular has been with us since she moved to Austin almost ten years ago, another since she was a teenager, and plenty of moms bring their daughters. Many ask for Ms. Kelly by name for their nails and eyebrows, and Cindy and Tina are known for careful pedicures and great massages. We're open seven days a week and walk-ins are always welcome. Weekends get busy, so come early or give us a call before you head over.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk-ins are welcome every day we're open. Weekends are busy, so come early or call (512) 989-0565 to check the wait.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 9:30 am to 7:30 pm, and Sunday 11 am to 6 pm.
- Q: Where are you located?
  A: 12901 N Interstate Hwy 35, Austin, TX 78753, in the Shops at Tech Ridge next door to Dollar Tree. Look for the red Tip&ToeSpa sign.
- Q: What services do you offer?
  A: Regular, solar, pink & white, SNS dip and gel full sets and refills, manicures, gel manicures, French or American tips, silk wraps, nail repair, design, polish changes, spa and men's pedicures, paraffin, eyebrow waxing and eyelash extensions.
- Q: Do you do men's pedicures?
  A: Yes. Men's pedicure is on our board, and plenty of guys are regulars.
- Q: How much do services cost?
  A: Our full price list is posted on the board at the front desk. Call (512) 989-0565 and we're happy to tell you the price of any service.
- Q: Do you do eyebrow waxing and lashes?
  A: Yes. Plenty of clients get their brows waxed during the same visit as their nails, and we offer eyelash extensions too.
